MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

6. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 23
   D. 17

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

9. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 3

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 12

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

12. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

17. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 25

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

19. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 1

20. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

21. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

22. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

23. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

24. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
